comments.text:
As someone who did the raids back then, it's just more veterans looking back at things with rose tinted goggles. They only remember how cool the experience was, not the recruiting VERY SPECIFICLY built frames for LoR or the absolutely buggy mess that was JV.

I completed LoR a handful of times, but wasn't lucky enough to get an arcane helmet. JV, however.....I think I only completed 1 singular time. And that wasn't for lack of trying. The raid would bug out and lock progression so easily that it just wasn't worth the frustration.

Would I like to see raids return? Sure, I think almost all of us vets would. Would it be feasible on a game that still requires peer to peer? No. Not at all. That was another part of the puzzle back then too. And while technology has made leaps and bounds, there is no guarantee you won't get someone with a potato PC/old gen console.

comments.text:
One problem I don't see enough people bringing up about raids is that the game never told you they existed!

 It isn't like ETA or Descendia where there's dedicated NPCs or a pop up menu telling you they've been unlocked. I remember having to purchase a key from the market and waiting nearly an hour trying to recruit people, ignoring the fact Host migrations were probably at there worst, recruiting wouldn't have taken as long if there was a dedicated tab or some UI element like Railjack in navigation, that not only informs the player that RAIDS EXIST but people are RECRUITING to play. 

I agree that no matter what, Raids would be a niche game mode, but famously in Skill Up's review of Warframe (at the time he was popular in the community for giving eyes to the game) he says there are no raids in the game, when in fact raids were still in the game pre POE lmao. But the fact that after all those hours the game never told him is why I think a lot of players (my self included) want to see Rebecca's modern team with their quality of life and creativity, give it a second chance after everything they've learned from Duviri to Perita rebellion.
